evidence: registration_layout validates an existing reparse-free parent directory under P05 and a run UUID in its name; it does not establish that this is a fresh/current Root staging parent.

The stage-code preallocation guard only checks that the three selected stage/draft/native child paths are absent. No check refuses existing files, other directories or an old manifest in the registration namespace itself.

allocation_check(metadata=False) protects REF parents actually supplied in the stage input plus GATE/BINDER/current producer. The layout namespace and paths are plain strings; an unrelated old receipt namespace is not a protected REF parent merely because it is selected as the layout target.

With an external stage input/current source, a nonempty old UUID-named namespace and three fresh child labels, all listed stage predicates can pass. entry creates the stage child and stage_sources writes source/bootstrap evidence inside the old tree. A later scope/review is not consulted by the initial stage action. This changes closed original membership even when every old file byte remains identical.

minimum_fix: In the stage-code branch of preallocate, before leaf/mkdir/request/raw/source copies, require the initial registration namespace to be empty and recheck this guard immediately before allocation. Do not place the empty-parent check in registration_layout for later stages, which legitimately contain stage/draft/native children.

Keep bootstrap input and reviewed source refs outside this parent; tighten required-input-contract.json to make that initial placement explicit. Root creates only the new empty parent before the first stage call.

Retain exact current layout/run UUID, safe/reparse checks, all three absent outputs, existing REF-parent exclusion, disjoint phase roots, and no retry. Refuse any old manifest/file/unrelated child without writing in that tree.

An equivalent actual Root creation/ownership proof with explicit permitted initial members could replace emptiness, but actor strings alone are insufficient; the empty-parent guard is the smallest correction.
